purpose: Keep disabled translation mounts, exact distance joints, distance limits, world-axis translation locks, world-axis translation limits, fixed-direction locks and fixed-direction limits in validated evidence while excluding them from solver residuals and collision-isolation topology before one-step delegation.

properties.constraints: any supported seven-family translation constraint set with optional enabled=false
properties.options: optional isolateCollisions boolean plus nested composer/isolation options

limitations: direct lower-level composer/isolation entrypoints retain their own compatibility semantics
disabled definitions are still normalized and therefore must reference valid bodies
axis-lock, axis-limit, fixed-direction-lock and fixed-direction-limit filtering does not imply rotating axes, angular limits or motor semantics
fixed-direction locks and limits remain fixed in world space and leave perpendicular translation free; direction-limit range interiors remain slack
collision isolation remains component-wide across enabled edges when requested

proves: disabled legacy-family constraints remain physically and topologically inert through the guarded route
disabled fixed-direction limits are retained in evidence but excluded from solving and topology while enabled limits still delegate through one donor-core step

truth.basis: The gate distinguishes validated retained definitions from the active subset actually delegated across all seven families.

agency.basis: Caller enabled=false choices are honored as inert across all seven supported families.

continuity.basis: The guarded route grows with the composer while preserving donor source and prior family behavior.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Filtering remains explicit and bounded instead of hiding disabled edges inside residual or topology calculations.
